name: 141 market-mix held-out check (closing odds)

window.why: after the generator/fit data (coefficients fit on 2010..2025) and after the 139 final-odds repair gap (2026-06-27..08-09 stored win odds are pre-race values)

population: races with race_date in window, track_type <> '障', results present
market_ev.build_features race_ok (every started horse has odds) and no dead heat (exactly one finished winner)
the winner's stored win odds x 100 equals the official 単勝 payout within 10 yen (the stored odds are the final values)
predictions: production as-of features (market_ev.load_rows since 2007 -> build_features) on the stored final odds; p_bar = mean of the 15 mev-ens15-v1 2026 boosters (ensemble_2026.json); p_mix = horseracing_eval.market_mix with the frozen 2026 coefficients
metrics: race-normalized winner NLL of p_bar and of p_mix (one value per race)
EV bands (<=0.8, 0.8-1.0, 1.0-1.2, 1.2-1.5, >1.5) of EV=p_bar*odds and EV_mix=p_mix*odds: n, won, sum p, sum won / sum p
sets raw EV>1.0, raw EV>1.2 (=S3), EV_mix>1.0: n, won, sum won/sum p, ROI settled on the official payout
paired: winner NLL difference (mix - raw) per race; race-day block bootstrap B=4000 seed=20261019; 95% percentile interval

rule.display_enabled_if: point estimate of (mix - raw) winner NLL <= 0, OR the 95% interval lower bound <= 0 (not significantly worse)
recorded_only: EV_mix>1.0 sum won/sum p and its interval

disclaimers: ROI の改善を示すものではない
確定オッズでの確認。発走前オッズでの表示値は別に記録する
